text: hey it's Tom and Mike from take time to travel hoyan is home to a UNESCO world heritage site and it's an incredibly beautiful city with so many delicious food options today we're going to show you some of hoyan's best restaurants as well as its tasty desserts and a couple of its amazing coffee shops first we'll start at a popular Bond me shop recommended by Anthony Bourdain it's called bon Mi Huang let's head inside and give it a try right at the front you can order takeout and see them making bonmies but we're going to the back to find a table and have some lunch to drink we ordered a couple of Huda beers for 20 000 dong each then to eat we ordered two different bonmi's Tom decided to get the mixed banmi which was loaded with lots of toppings and I chose the grilled pork Bon me which also looked very tasty both were delicious although Tom seemed to have some struggles taking his first bite quit gave me a good laugh we really enjoyed ban me fuang but let's keep going and show you some more food options we had to walk around many motorbikes to get to the next place which is another popular spot called The White Rose restaurant let's make our way in and check it out at the back we saw all of these ladies making their specialty the white rose dumplings by hand from a secret recipe then we sat down and ordered a couple of Saigon beers that cost twenty thousand dong each as well as their specialty the white rose dumplings which are a type of shrimp dumpling made from translucent white dough bunched up to look like roses we don't think that they look like roses but they did taste really good in addition we ordered the fried wonton plate also known as the Hoi An Pizza it's large crispy wontons are top to a shrimp and tomato roulade the fried wontons were delicious and were actually our favorite the White Rose restaurant was definitely worth the visit next we'll head into hoyan's ancient town to sit on a picturesque patio for dinner at the Morning Glory original restaurant let's give this beautiful place a try inside there's High wooden beam ceilings with seating surrounding a central kitchen area but we sat on the porch and had a couple of Huda beers while we waited for our table on the patio to be ready when our table was ready we moved on to the patio and placed our order we got the cowlau which is one of Hoi An Specialties with thick udon style noodles Char shu pork croutons and Vietnamese herbs as well as the green mango salad with poached shrimp spicy chicken and fresh herbs both the cowlau and the Green Mango go salad were tasty but I think the kala was our favorite then for dessert we shared the Vietnamese banana ice cream which was delicious overall we really enjoyed our meal and the setting at Morning Glory just a couple of minutes walk away is another great restaurant in the ancient town called The hoyanian Wine Bar and restaurant where we're going to have dinner tonight we went upstairs to the second floor to grab a table on their cute little balcony which had picturesque views overlooking the thubon river and the busy street below to start we had a couple of the root beers and it was happy hour so it was buy one get one free then as an appetizer we ordered the duck spring roll stuffed with onion mushrooms carrot basil and duck meat which came with a dipping sauce and tasted great for our main course I chose the soft shell crab the crab was battered and sauteed with Tamarind sauce and served with rice and Tom got the Vietnamese green curry which is a homemade curry with coconut milk eggplant okra sweet basil and chicken breast which also came with a side of rice the homemade green curry as well as the soft shell crab were both delicious if you're looking for some dessert make sure to check out M's Bakery inside isn't very big but they do have a nice selection of sweets there were so many tempting options that it was hard to decide what to get because everything looks so good we ended up ordering a lot we got this pretty little lemon tart as well as this huge panel chocolate an appetizing slice of raspberry tart and a mouth-watering shoe pastry with pistachio cream the panel chocolate and the raspberry tart were very good but my favorite it was the pistachio cream pastry and toms was the lemon tart next we'll head over to hoyan's and bang beach to have lunch at a beachfront restaurant with lovely views let's head up this Sandy path and go give it a try it's called the deck house and bang beach and as soon as we walked in we saw a big boat of seafood going by as well as palm trees situated amongst the tables and loungers giving the patio quite a tropical Vibe I enjoyed the beautiful views overlooking the sea from our table while Tom browsed over the Restaurant's menu then we started our meal with a couple of cold Buddha beers to enjoy on this hot day cheers those really hit the spot nicely for some food Mike chose the green papaya salad with grilled calamari and I had the deck house mango salad with shrimp carrot onion and mint both salads were huge and were very tasty but our favorite part was relaxing on the deck and enjoying the amazing beachfront scenery just across the Sandy pathway where we came in the deck house has another attractive bar and seating area with a pool in the middle which also looked like a great spot to relax and spend the afternoon after that we'll try one of hoyan's best coffee shops called Uncle Juan coffee let's head inside and give it a try upstairs on the second floor there's this nice little seating area and Outback there's this lovely view where down below there's some hanging lanterns and across the reflecting pool you can see the bamu temple through the trees to drink Tom ordered the egg coffee which had this cute little tree and Bird design on it the Vietnamese egg coffee was really creamy and super tasty Tom loved it I ordered the coconut coffee which was served cold with a coconut flavored ice blend in the middle the coconut coffee was delicious and I'm not even a coffee fan Uncle Juan's is definitely a great choice for some coffee another great spot to grab a coffee in Hoi an's ancient town with a fabulous view is at the 92 Station restaurant and Cafe let's make our way inside and show you around the cafe has a cool seating area on the first floor but we're going to head upstairs past the nicely decorated second floor and up to their open air Third Floor Terrace which was our favorite with its lovely views of the ancient towns rooftops love all the pretty hanging plants along the railing and how you can have a bird's eye view overlooking the beautiful Street down below what a wonderful place to relax and have a drink as we enjoyed the view Tom had the banana smoothie with banana yogurt and milk and I chose the coconut coffee which is served cold with coconut milk and coffee smoothie the the cold drinks were the perfect way to cool down on a hot afternoon this place also has a rooftop Terrace with lots of seating up here as well as some nice plants and Greenery although the best part is its panoramic views overlooking the rooftops of hoi an's ancient town I think this might be one of the tallest buildings in this area giving it an incredible perspective but it's really hot up here so let's keep going and try some more food for our next restaurant we'll walk down this narrow laneway in the ancient town over to seashell by new Eatery for our dinner reservation we were seated at a table right by the window in one of the restaurants cozy dining areas then we ordered a couple of Huda beers while we looked over the menu to eat we shared the fresh tempura shrimp rolls with avocado and peanut sauce as well as a bowl of sweet potato soup with curry croutons and yogurt we really enjoyed both but I especially liked the shrimp rolls dipped in the peanut sauce they were amazing in addition we also shared the lemongrass pork bowl with Jasmine rice Market vegetables coleslaw and Green Mango then for dessert we split the banana cream pie with dark chocolate and caramelized banana on the side which was delicious just like everything else well we hope you enjoyed our Hoi An food tour and we gave you some good ideas on where to eat if we did we would really appreciate it if you'd like subscribe and hit the bell for notifications on our future videos like the best things to do in Hoi An and remember take time to travel catch you on the next one
